name: agents-md

name: blog-writing-guide

Also trigger when the user mentions "blog post," "blog draft," "write-up," "announcement post," "engineering post," "deep dive," "postmortem," or asks for help with technical writing for Sentry. Even if the user just says "help me write about [feature/topic]" — if it sounds like it could become a Sentry blog post, use this skill.

name: commit

name: create-branch

name: pr-writer

name: secret-serialization

Use when asked to "check for secret serialization", "credential in repr", "repr=False audit", "secret in spans", "token in logs", or when a change adds a credential field to a dataclass, model, or config object, or adds code that stringifies whole objects or every kwarg into telemetry.'

name: security-review
